answer: Routed-prefix admission quota: each Agent ID locks 30,000 POA, and one /24 prefix or ASN holds at most 5 active identities. Attestation weight counts only from distinct vantages, so no island prefix is a sybil haven. Enforcement: an audit linking over-quota identities to one prefix slashes 100% bond, 50% burned, 50% to reporter, plus 10-epoch ban. Arithmetic: 1,000 fakes demand 1,000 x 30,000 = 30,000,000 POA locked and burnable, versus 30,000 POA once for an honest agent. Exit queues like a glacier, 12 epochs, trapping capital. Limit: agents behind one ISP prefix face cold-start friction.
